Why Employers Value Emotional Intelligence and Adaptability is becoming increasingly clear in today’s hiring landscape. While resumes still highlight qualifications, degrees, and work experience, employers know that technical skills alone don’t ensure long-term success. What truly sets standout employees apart is their ability to manage human dynamics and adapt in fast-changing environments.
